info.name: Skillo Mobile API
info.description: Complete API collection for Skillo mobile application including authentication, user onboarding, home page dynamic content with personalization and category filtering, comprehensive course details, mentor details, review management, course enrollment, session booking with Stripe payment integration (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover), and unified conversation system for both students and mentors

item.name: Authentication

request.description: Register a new user account. Only users can register through API, mentors cannot self-register.
Authenticate user and return access token. Both users and mentors can login.
Get current authenticated user information
Logout user and invalidate token
Refresh authentication token
Send password reset link to user email
Reset user password using token from email

item.description: Authentication endpoints for user registration, login, logout, and password management

item.name: Onboarding - Public

request.description: Get all available categories with their subcategories. Shows which subcategories are custom and who created them.
Get list of available countries for location selection

item.description: Public onboarding endpoints that don't require authentication

item.name: Onboarding - Protected

request.description: Save user's category and subcategory selection. If 'Others' category is selected with custom_category_name, creates a new custom subcategory.
Save user's education type preference (in-person or online)
Save user's location preference for in-person education
Save user's online education preferences (courses, mentoring, or both)
Get current onboarding progress and next step
Get user's saved preferences including category, education type, location, etc.
Get all custom subcategories created by the current user

item.description: Protected onboarding endpoints that require authentication

item.name: Home Page Data

request.description: Retrieve top-rated mentors with preference matching for logged-in users
Retrieve popular courses based on ratings and reviews, with preference matching for logged-in users
Retrieve newest courses ordered by creation date, with preference matching for logged-in users
Retrieve manually selected featured courses
Retrieve top-rated reviews (4+ stars) for testimonials section

query.description: Filter all data by category ID (optional)

request.description: Retrieve all home page data in a single request for better performance

item.description: Home page dynamic content endpoints with personalization for logged-in users

item.name: Review Management

request.description: Create a new review for a course or mentor. Use course_id for course reviews or mentor_id for mentor reviews.

query.description: Filter by type: all, course, mentor

request.description: Retrieve paginated list of user's reviews with optional filtering by type.
Retrieve details of a specific review.
Update an existing review. Users can only update their own reviews.
Delete a review. Users can only delete their own reviews.

query.description: Mentor ID to check eligibility (use either course_id or mentor_id)

request.description: Check if user can review a specific course or mentor before attempting to create a review.

item.description: Review management endpoints for creating, reading, updating, and deleting reviews for courses and mentors

item.name: Course Enrollment

request.description: Get course enrollment information and checkout details for a specific course. Returns pricing, eligibility, and course details.
Enroll in a course with payment processing using Stripe. Supports Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and Discover cards. Requires valid payment method ID from Stripe Elements.

query.description: Filter by enrollment status (all, pending, active, completed, cancelled, refunded)

request.description: Get all course enrollments for the authenticated user with pagination and status filtering.
Get detailed information about a specific enrollment including course details, transaction info, and conversation status.
Course enrollments cannot be cancelled after payment. All enrollments are final once payment is completed.

item.description: Course enrollment endpoints for enrolling in courses with Stripe payment integration (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover), managing enrollments, and tracking progress

item.name: Session Booking

request.description: Get available session bookings with optional filtering by mentor, category, and date.
Get session booking information and checkout details for a specific session. Returns pricing, eligibility, and session details.
Book a session with payment processing using Stripe. Supports Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and Discover cards. Requires valid payment method ID from Stripe Elements.

query.description: Filter by enrollment status (all, pending, active, completed, cancelled, refunded)

request.description: Get all session bookings for the authenticated user with pagination and status filtering.
Get detailed information about a specific session booking including session details, transaction info, and conversation status.
Session bookings cannot be cancelled after payment. Users can only switch to another available session with the same mentor and price.
Get available sessions for switching (same mentor, same price). Only shows future sessions with the same mentor and price as the current booking.
Switch to a different session with same mentor and price. The new session must be available and have the same mentor and price as the current booking.

item.description: Session booking endpoints for browsing available sessions, booking sessions with Stripe payment integration (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover), managing bookings, and tracking session progress
